subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should these two MCP entrypoints intentionally expose one diagnostic schema, or are their distinct service prefixes part of the supported operator contract?
rationale: Source similarity alone cannot determine whether the service identity is duplicated formatting or intentional ownership metadata, and the recent clean-stdout fix makes that distinction protocol-sensitive.

options.title: Confirm a narrow shared contract
options.body: Share only generic error-to-text normalization and retain each service's prefix and stderr routing.

options.title: Keep service-local formatting
options.body: Close the cleanup request if the differing prefixes are intentional and no conflicting structured output can be demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Confirm a narrow shared contract
recommendation.body: Share only generic error-to-text normalization and retain each service's prefix and stderr routing.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history trail points most directly to the original OpenClaw tools MCP bridge introduction.
